### 4. Scored parameters

Decision date 2026-10-09.

**(a) Refund credit on 3406634d (order e872aed6)**
- Baseline (computation statement): order of the most recent seller-funded refund debit (2026-10-01 → e872aed6); creditable 691.55 − 0.00; refunded share = 1950.00/9800.00 = 0.19898; credit before fee = round(creditable × share); admin = round(credit × 20%) capped at 5.00.
- Refunded share bands: 0.19898 ≤ 25% (small-refund share) → half of proportional = 0.099490 → 691.55 × 0.099490 = 68.802 → **68.80**.
- Admin rate: level Above Standard Level (`find_seller_standing`), order defects dated within the last 2 whole months (after 2026-08-09): none (only defect is negative_feedback 2026-06-24) → above refund admin rate 15%.
- Frequency multiplier: seller-funded refund debits within the last three whole months: 2026-08-12 and 2026-10-01 = 2 → 1.25.
- Tenure multiplier: verified 2023-09-15 → 36 whole months to 2026-10-09 → 0.5.
- Fee: 68.80 × 15% × 1.25 × 0.5 = 6.45 (no rounding-moment sensitivity: 10.32 × 0.625 = 6.45 exactly); cap: basis 9800 ≥ 1000 → 10.00 → 6.45.
- FBN relief after the cap: FBN outbound shipment for e872aed6 dated 2026-09-03, a later day than the variable fee record (2026-09-02) → 1.50 → fee withheld **4.95**.
- Credit **63.85**; credit_reason order_refund.
- Fall-back: 691.55 × 0.19898 = 137.60; fee 27.52 → cap 5.00; credit 132.60 (≠ 63.85).

**(b) Early termination fee (scored on the seller's closure)** — after (a)
- Baseline (calculation sheet): annual term monthly fee × remaining committed months × ETF share, rounded once. Anchor: 299.95; remaining committed months = whole months 2026-10-15 → 2027-09-14 (10) + 1 = 11; share 50% (tier table).
- Renewal rule: term start 2026-09-15 is later than verification 2023-09-15 → renewed automatically; 24 days before 2026-10-09 (≤ 30 grace days) → months counted = 3 − whole months from 2026-09-15 to next billing 2026-10-15 (1) = **2**.
- Loyalty relief: regular subscription charges billed on the plan in all = 37 (2023-09-15 … 2026-09-15) → ≥36 → 8 points.
- Standing relief: Above Standard Level, violation_points 0 → 5 points.
- Volume relief: net seller fees with billing date less than 12 whole months before 2026-10-09 (after 2025-10-09; the 2025-10-07 order fees are outside): billed 12040.92 − credits 10.84 = 12030.08 before today; after booking (a) (63.85) → **11966.23** → USD 6000–11999.99 → 10 points.
- Share = 50 − (8 + 5 + 10) = 27%. ETF = 299.95 × 2 × 27% = 161.973 → **161.97**.
- Fall-back (baseline only): 299.95 × 11 × 50% = 1649.725 → 1649.73 (definite, ≠ 161.97).
- "Do only the closure" (refund credit skipped): volume 15 points → share 22% → 131.98 — different and excluded by the hub's prerequisite sentence.

Factor findability: plan record term_start/verified_date/next_billing → KB_search "plan verification date tenure months" returns "Committed Months after an Automatic Annual Renewal" (whose opening names the plan record fields); subscription fee records "regular" → loyalty doc ("Loyalty is counted from the plan's subscription fee records of the regular charge type"); standing level + violation points → "Performance Standing Relief on Early Termination Fees" (KB_search "active violation points performance level" rank 1); fee records → "Net Fee Volume Relief" (rank 2 for "net seller fees last twelve months"). For the refund credit: ledger refund debits → "Refund Frequency Multiplier" and "Refunded Share Bands"; plan verification → refund tenure multiplier; standing defects → refund admin rate doc; FBN outbound shipment → refund FBN relief; fee basis → refund admin caps. No computation document hints at a variation.
